# Mohammad Syful Hoque — development economist, Dhaka

> Costing, cost-benefit and financing analysis, feasibility studies, surveys and evaluation, and policy research for Bangladesh and international clients. Every figure on the site has an address and a source in the Evidence Ledger.

## Services
- [Feasibility studies & project preparation](https://syful-hoque.example/services/feasibility-studies/): Feasibility studies and project preparation that give an approving body what it needs to decide: technical, financial, economic, social and market feasibility, costed implementation and financing plans, and results frameworks — in the approving institution’s own format.
- [Cost-benefit & financial analysis](https://syful-hoque.example/services/cost-benefit-analysis/): Economic and financial appraisal that tells a funder whether a project is worth its cost — ENPV, EIRR, FNPV, FIRR, benefit-cost ratios and switching values, costed and financed, and built to the approving institution’s guidelines.
- [Policy research & advocacy — Bangladesh & international](https://syful-hoque.example/services/policy-research-advocacy/): Policy research for Bangladesh and the region that is designed to be used: survey and qualitative evidence, gap and constraint analysis, policy briefs, and structured dialogue with the people who decide.
- [Management consulting, M&E & evaluation](https://syful-hoque.example/services/management-consulting-me/): Management consulting for public programmes and institutions: results frameworks and measurement systems, impact evaluations including randomised trials, and the governance, financing and investment plans that let an institution deliver.
- [Data stories & decision technology](https://syful-hoque.example/services/data-stories-technology/): Data and technology put to work on a decision: firm and household surveys, policy databases and indices, appraisal of digital and AI programmes, GIS-informed pipelines — and reports that turn the data into a story someone can act on.

## Record
- [Work board — 37 documented assignments](https://syful-hoque.example/work/)
- [Evidence ledger](https://syful-hoque.example/evidence/)
- [What should early warning cost?](https://syful-hoque.example/work/adb-ews-facility/): Economic and financial analysis for a regional ADB technical assistance on early-warning systems, with ten countries in scope. Costing toolkits and cost-benefit models developed; economic and financial chapters and financing structures in preparation.
- [Costing a modern madrasah education.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/nsep-madrasah/): Technical, financial and institutional feasibility for secondary and higher-secondary madrasah education, including costed plans for ICT labs, science labs and solar learning environments.
- [Building the investment case for skills.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/nsep-tvet/): Economic and financial appraisal, costing and financing analysis for technical and vocational education, including sections of a Planning Commission-compliant feasibility report.
- [Appraising digital learning for primary schools.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/nextgen-primary-gpe/): Feasibility for NextGen primary education in Bangladesh, including the technical feasibility and cost-benefit models for digital and AI-powered learning and assessment.
- [Appraising secondary and madrasah education.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/nsep-56088/): ENPV and FNPV, EIRR and FIRR and benefit-cost ratios with scenario-based sensitivity, built as Excel models and narratives for Planning Commission-format feasibility reports.
- [What will make a green transition possible?](https://syful-hoque.example/work/green-transition-rmg/): Research into the policy, institutional and financing barriers facing Bangladesh’s textile and ready-made garment industries — from research design to policy briefs.
- [Appraising a national gateway.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/payra-port/): Economic and financial analysis to support infrastructure investment decisions for Payra Seaport Authority, including a 15-year financial model.
- [Testing the case for a new city.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/jolshiri/): Economic, social, financial and market feasibility for a proposed urban development with a stated capital investment of USD 1,414 million.
- [Understanding the future of manufacturing.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/fat-survey/): A firm-level technology adoption survey for the World Bank: questionnaire, programming guidance, fieldwork training, data quality control and analysis for a policy report covering eight manufacturing sectors.
- [Evidence for energy-efficient technology.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/rct-stitching-motors/): A randomised controlled trial with the World Bank, Johns Hopkins and Columbia on how managers’ beliefs about energy-efficient stitching motors change with information: design support, piloting, implementation and analysis.
- [Preparing for a changing trade landscape.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/ec-ldc-graduation/): Trade, business and financing analysis to inform Bangladesh’s graduation transition and opportunities for EU engagement, as Deputy Team Leader.
- [Did the energy investments perform as projected?](https://syful-hoque.example/work/esmap-astae/): Ex-post financial and economic evaluation of energy programmes in Bangladesh and Nepal: CAPEX, OPEX, ROI and the levelised cost of energy, compared with the original projections.
- [Financing greener municipal infrastructure.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/bmdf-green-municipal/): Viability, cost-benefit analysis and a ten-year financial roadmap for municipal renewable energy, street lighting and waste-to-energy, with GIS-informed investment pipelines.
- [Background for a country economic memorandum.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/cem-bangladesh-india/): Thematic and sectoral background research, including key informant interviews, for the World Bank’s Country Economic Memorandums.
- [Greening trade and investment policy.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/green-trade-reform/): Scoping, stakeholder and institutional mapping and policy-gap analysis on trade, investment and finance for environmental goods and services, contributing to the World Bank’s Bangladesh trade and climate report.
- [Mapping productive capacity gaps.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/unctad-pcga/): A Productive Capacities Gap Assessment for Bangladesh with UNCTAD and CPD: productive capacities index analysis, binding constraints and policy recommendations for LDC graduation.
- [Putting services-trade rules into data.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/wto-services-trade/): Bangladesh entries for the World Bank–WTO Global Services Trade Policy Database and Index, compiled from regulatory desk research and interviews.
- [Financing a city’s long-term vision.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/dscc-vision-2050/): Preparatory studies for Dhaka South City Corporation’s Vision 2050: a city financing and investment plan, a governance reform plan, and business and revenue models.
- [Worker health, productivity and the business case.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/halow/): M&E adviser and impact evaluation expert for the HALOW+ partnership: a randomised trial, health and productivity databases, cost-benefit and business value analysis.
- [A results framework for sanitation.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/dsip-dwasa/): An M&E and results framework for a five-year World Bank sanitation operation in Dhaka.
- [Equity rules for infrastructure finance.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/jica-beza-biffl/): Equity investment policy, special-purpose company formulation, shareholder and project agreements for BIFFL and BEZA, supporting the JICA team.
- [Measuring regulatory reform.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/bicf-ifc/): Results measurement and evaluation for IFC’s Bangladesh Investment Climate Fund: RBM tools, business confidence surveys, and evaluation of 20 simplification and automation projects.
- [Making a banking system legible to its regulator.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/adb-fsi-reta/): National consultant on ADB’s regional technical assistance for financial soundness indicators: balance-sheet data for 400 non-financial corporations and indicator guidelines for Bangladesh Bank and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics.
- [Designing results-based finance for off-grid energy.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/global-leap/): Results-based financing design for Global LEAP: viability-gap estimation, cost-recovery frameworks, cost-benefit analysis and a four-year M&E framework.
- [Counting the cost of cargo loss.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/sarti-cargo/): A regional trade-logistics study for IFC using historical trader data (2007–2013) on cargo loss and damage across Bangladesh, India and Nepal.
- [Technology for the smallest farms.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/tiga-bmgf/): Ex-ante impact assessment and farm-household segmentation for inclusive technology adoption, with baseline and endline surveys and RCT design support, for the Gates Foundation.
- [Regulating power across three countries.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/resa-electricity/): Economic and financial feasibility of electricity regulatory reforms in Bangladesh, India and Nepal: tariffs, cost recovery, subsidies and a comparative cost-benefit analysis.
- [The economics of a tobacco tax.](https://syful-hoque.example/work/tobacco-taxation/): Price-elasticity estimation, a tax-administration review and advocacy — roundtables, direct lobbying and media — for effective tobacco taxation.
